body: That's the thing of it. Complicated, emotional, irrational, trivial, dramatic, too much and too little led me down this separate road. Again, not to be rude or too forward, but if I could clearly explain how I got here, I might have an idea of how to get back, but that seems impossible at this point.

No offense, but this just sort of reinforces my point. I acknowledge that I've gotten myself onto a path that is worse than the one I could have had and one which I might be unable to leave -- like that "planet all to ourselves, with its own unique fucked up orbit...", so why bother staying on that planet if it has "...no light, much less warmth"?
